name: Memorandum of Understanding With Police
description: Safe Schools Act MOU with township police setting procedures for specified incidents on school property, at activities and on school transportation; kept current and attached to the AR.
quote: a Memorandum of Understanding is developed with the Cheltenham Township Police Department which outlines the procedures to be followed when certain incidents contemplated by the Pennsylvania Safe Schools act occur on school property, at any school sponsored activity, or on a conveyance providing transportation to or from school or a school sponsored activity.
